hud_urban_land_price_to_cost.name: New-build sale price to construction cost
hud_urban_land_price_to_cost.caveat: HUD's annual Gisborne District ratio for all residential building types, year ended June. New-build sale prices per square metre are divided by estimated construction costs per square metre, including HUD's cost allowances.

sa2_under_15.name: People aged under 15
sa2_under_15.caveat: Share of the Census usually resident population.

sa2_age_65_plus.name: People aged 65 and over
sa2_age_65_plus.caveat: Share of the Census usually resident population.

sa2_maori_ethnicity.name: Māori ethnicity
sa2_maori_ethnicity.caveat: Share of people with a stated ethnicity. People can identify with more than one ethnicity.

sa2_te_reo_maori.name: People who speak te reo Māori
sa2_te_reo_maori.caveat: Share of people with a stated language response who can hold an everyday conversation in te reo Māori.

sa2_median_household_income.name: Median household income
sa2_median_household_income.caveat: Median annual total household income in New Zealand dollars, for households in occupied private dwellings.

sa2_home_ownership.name: Home owned or held in a family trust
sa2_home_ownership.caveat: Share of households with stated tenure whose dwelling is owned, partly owned, or held in a family trust.

sa2_household_crowding.name: Households that are crowded
sa2_household_crowding.caveat: Share of households with a stated crowding status that need at least one more bedroom under the Canadian National Occupancy Standard.

sa2_dwelling_dampness.name: Dwellings that are damp
sa2_dwelling_dampness.caveat: Share of occupied private dwellings with a stated response that are sometimes or always damp.

sa2_internet_access.name: Households with internet access
sa2_internet_access.caveat: Share of households with a stated telecommunications response that have internet access.

gisborne_stand_down_cases.name: School stand-downs
gisborne_stand_down_cases.caveat: Published cases at schools in Gisborne District. Case counts describe school decisions and may count a student more than once.

gisborne_suspension_cases.name: School suspensions
gisborne_suspension_cases.caveat: Published cases at schools in Gisborne District. Case counts describe school decisions and may count a student more than once.

gisborne_exclusion_cases.name: School exclusions
gisborne_exclusion_cases.caveat: Published cases at schools in Gisborne District. Exclusion is the formal removal of a student under 16.

gisborne_expulsion_cases.name: School expulsions
gisborne_expulsion_cases.caveat: Published cases at schools in Gisborne District. Expulsion is the formal removal of a student aged 16 or over.

gisborne_council_operating_income.name: Council operating income
gisborne_council_operating_income.caveat: Core non-trading activities of Gisborne District Council, year ended June, in current New Zealand dollars.

gisborne_council_operating_expenditure.name: Council operating expenditure
gisborne_council_operating_expenditure.caveat: Core non-trading activities of Gisborne District Council, year ended June, in current New Zealand dollars.

river_ecoli_median.name: Median E. coli at monitored river sites
river_ecoli_median.caveat: Measured site medians per 100 mL over 2020–2024. This monitoring-period snapshot differs from current conditions. See the publisher for methods.

swimming_freshwater_ecoli.name: Freshwater swimming sites · E. coli
swimming_freshwater_ecoli.caveat: Historical routine samples by river site from the reviewed LAWA release. The < and > signs identify lab reporting limits.

swimming_coastal_enterococci.name: Coastal swimming sites · enterococci
swimming_coastal_enterococci.caveat: Historical routine samples by coastal site from the reviewed LAWA release. The < and > signs identify lab reporting limits.

gisborne_live_births.name: Registered live births
gisborne_live_births.caveat: Gisborne Region by usual residence of the mother, for the December year. Stats NZ applies random rounding.

gisborne_registered_deaths.name: Registered deaths
gisborne_registered_deaths.caveat: Gisborne Region by usual residence of the deceased, for the December year. Stats NZ applies random rounding.

gisborne_july_school_roll.name: July school roll
gisborne_july_school_roll.caveat: Published headcount as at 1 July for schools located in Gisborne District.

gisborne_maori_medium_roll.name: Māori-medium school enrolment
gisborne_maori_medium_roll.caveat: Students enrolled as at 1 July at schools located in Gisborne District. Includes Māori-language immersion levels 1 and 2, where students are taught in te reo Māori for at least 51% of the time.

gisborne_prior_ece_participation.name: Early learning participation before starting school
gisborne_prior_ece_participation.caveat: Share of children starting school in Gisborne District who regularly attended early learning in the preceding six months. Quarterly points cover the year ended that quarter. Children with unknown attendance are excluded.

gisborne_population_projection_low.name: Population projection · low
gisborne_population_projection_low.caveat: Stats NZ 2023-base low scenario for Gisborne Region at 30 June. Values are projections under stated assumptions.

gisborne_population_projection_medium.name: Population projection · medium
gisborne_population_projection_medium.caveat: Stats NZ 2023-base medium scenario for Gisborne Region at 30 June. Values are projections under stated assumptions.

gisborne_population_projection_high.name: Population projection · high
gisborne_population_projection_high.caveat: Stats NZ 2023-base high scenario for Gisborne Region at 30 June. Values are projections under stated assumptions.

gisborne_residential_electricity.name: Average residential electricity consumption
gisborne_residential_electricity.caveat: Average kilowatt-hours drawn from the grid per residential connection in Gisborne Region. Self-consumed generation and weather adjustments are excluded.

gisborne_filled_jobs.name: Filled jobs
gisborne_filled_jobs.caveat: Actual monthly filled jobs in Gisborne Region from Stats NZ employment indicators. Jobs are counted rather than individual people. Recent months may be revised.

gisborne_new_dwellings_consented.name: New dwellings consented
gisborne_new_dwellings_consented.caveat: Monthly counts for Gisborne District. A consent is an approval and does not record a completed dwelling.

gisborne_building_consent_value.name: Value of building consents
gisborne_building_consent_value.caveat: New and altered construction combined for Gisborne District, at current prices in New Zealand dollars.

gisborne_guest_nights.name: Commercial accommodation guest nights
gisborne_guest_nights.caveat: Gisborne Region estimates cover commercial accommodation with at least six stay units. Monthly figures are estimates and may be revised.

gisborne_active_accommodation.name: Active commercial accommodation establishments
gisborne_active_accommodation.caveat: Gisborne Region estimates cover commercial accommodation with at least six stay units.

gisborne_census_families.name: Families in occupied private dwellings
gisborne_census_families.caveat: Published census counts for Gisborne Region. Stats NZ applies random rounding. Census methods changed across the 2013, 2018 and 2023 releases.

gisborne_census_households.name: Households in occupied private dwellings
gisborne_census_households.caveat: Published census counts for Gisborne Region. Stats NZ applies random rounding. Census methods changed across the 2013, 2018 and 2023 releases.

gisborne_nominal_gdp.name: Regional GDP at current prices (NZ$ million)
gisborne_nominal_gdp.caveat: Production measure, in millions of New Zealand dollars, for the year ended March. Changes include price changes.

gisborne_nominal_gdp_per_person.name: Regional GDP per person at current prices
gisborne_nominal_gdp_per_person.caveat: New Zealand dollars per person for the year ended March. Regional production per person differs from household income.

hud_house_price_to_income.name: Median house price to median household income
hud_house_price_to_income.caveat: The published Local Housing Statistics time series for Gisborne District.

hud_deposit_affordability.name: Deposit affordability index
hud_deposit_affordability.caveat: The HUD index compares house sale prices with median disposable household income over time.

hud_mortgage_affordability.name: Mortgage affordability index
hud_mortgage_affordability.caveat: The HUD index compares mortgage servicing costs with median disposable household income over time.

hud_rent_affordability.name: Rent affordability index
hud_rent_affordability.caveat: The HUD index compares rent prices on new bonds with median disposable household income over time.

school_leavers_level_2.name: School leavers with NCEA Level 2 or above
school_leavers_level_2.caveat: Percentage of school leavers with NCEA Level 2 or equivalent or above. Geography refers to the school’s location.

nzqa_ncea_level_1_year_11.name: Year 11 students attaining NCEA Level 1
nzqa_ncea_level_1_year_11.caveat: Participation-based: share of Year 11 students entered for 80 or more Level 1 credits who attained NCEA Level 1. NZQA secondary school statistics for its Gisborne region, defined by the location of the student's school. Cumulative attainment by the end of the year for domestic students aged under 19 enrolled at a secondary school. NZQA attainment differs from the Ministry of Education school-leaver measure, which counts the highest qualification held when students leave school. NZQA does not publish regional attainment by ethnicity.

nzqa_ncea_level_2_year_12.name: Year 12 students attaining NCEA Level 2
nzqa_ncea_level_2_year_12.caveat: Enrolment-based: share of all Year 12 students who attained NCEA Level 2. NZQA secondary school statistics for its Gisborne region, defined by the location of the student's school. Cumulative attainment by the end of the year for domestic students aged under 19 enrolled at a secondary school. NZQA attainment differs from the Ministry of Education school-leaver measure, which counts the highest qualification held when students leave school. NZQA does not publish regional attainment by ethnicity.

nzqa_ncea_level_3_year_13.name: Year 13 students attaining NCEA Level 3
nzqa_ncea_level_3_year_13.caveat: Enrolment-based: share of all Year 13 students who attained NCEA Level 3. NZQA secondary school statistics for its Gisborne region, defined by the location of the student's school. Cumulative attainment by the end of the year for domestic students aged under 19 enrolled at a secondary school. NZQA attainment differs from the Ministry of Education school-leaver measure, which counts the highest qualification held when students leave school. NZQA does not publish regional attainment by ethnicity.

nzqa_university_entrance_year_13.name: Year 13 students attaining University Entrance
nzqa_university_entrance_year_13.caveat: Enrolment-based: share of all Year 13 students who attained University Entrance. NZQA secondary school statistics for its Gisborne region, defined by the location of the student's school. Cumulative attainment by the end of the year for domestic students aged under 19 enrolled at a secondary school. NZQA attainment differs from the Ministry of Education school-leaver measure, which counts the highest qualification held when students leave school. NZQA does not publish regional attainment by ethnicity.

gisborne_mayoral_turnout.name: Gisborne mayoral turnout
gisborne_mayoral_turnout.caveat: Share of enrolled electors voting in the contested Gisborne District Council mayoral election. The table shows verified election snapshots.

gisborne_te_reo_speakers.name: People who can speak te reo Māori
gisborne_te_reo_speakers.caveat: The 2023 Census figure is for Gisborne Region. The question asks whether people can have a conversation about everyday things in te reo Māori.

regional_ghg_emissions.name: Gross greenhouse gas emissions
regional_ghg_emissions.caveat: Gisborne Region industry and household emissions, in kilotonnes of CO₂ equivalent. Uses the production approach and the residence principle. Excludes consumption-based emissions. Earlier years can be revised.

regular_school_attendance.name: Students attending school regularly
regular_school_attendance.caveat: Percentage of students in Gisborne Region state and state-integrated schools who attended more than 90% of the term. COVID-19 affected comparability in 2020 and 2021. Reporting changed from Term 1 2025. CSV dates are the corresponding calendar-quarter boundaries for indexing by term.

pop_estimate.name: Estimated resident population
pop_estimate.caveat: Estimated at 30 June. Rebased after each census (2023 rebase).

pop_median_age.name: Median age
pop_median_age.caveat: Half the population is older and half younger. Estimated at 30 June.

bds_geographic_units.name: Business locations (geographic units)
bds_geographic_units.caveat: Business locations (geographic units) with economic activity, at February each year. Counts randomly rounded.

bds_employee_count.name: Employees in business locations
bds_employee_count.caveat: Employee count at February. Counts randomly rounded.

leed_filled_jobs.name: Filled jobs (LEED, quarterly)
leed_filled_jobs.caveat: Total filled jobs in Gisborne Region from Stats NZ linked employer-employee data (LEED table 05). Jobs are counted rather than people. Published values are rounded. This quarterly series lags the monthly filled jobs series.

leed_median_quarterly_earnings.name: Median quarterly earnings, full-quarter jobs (LEED)
leed_median_quarterly_earnings.caveat: Median earnings for the quarter from jobs held for the full quarter in Gisborne Region, from Stats NZ LEED table 05. Gross earnings at current prices, not adjusted for inflation or hours worked. Published values are rounded.

leed_worker_turnover_rate.name: Worker turnover rate (LEED)
leed_worker_turnover_rate.caveat: Quarterly worker turnover rate (%) for Gisborne Region as published in Stats NZ LEED table 05. Turnover is seasonal, so compare the same quarter across years.

agr_sheep.name: Sheep
agr_sheep.caveat: Total sheep in Gisborne Region at 30 June, from Stats NZ Agricultural Production Statistics (ADE AGR_AGR_003). Census years (2002, 2007, 2012, 2017, 2022) are full counts; other years are survey estimates.

agr_beef_cattle.name: Beef cattle
agr_beef_cattle.caveat: Total beef cattle in Gisborne Region at 30 June, from Stats NZ Agricultural Production Statistics (ADE AGR_AGR_003). Census years are full counts; other years are survey estimates.

agr_kiwifruit_area.name: Kiwifruit area (hectares)
agr_kiwifruit_area.caveat: Kiwifruit area in Gisborne Region at 30 June, from Stats NZ Agricultural Production Statistics (ADE AGR_AGR_002). Horticulture is collected only in some years. Suppressed cells are left blank.

agr_apples_area.name: Apple orchard area (hectares)
agr_apples_area.caveat: Apple area in Gisborne Region at 30 June, from Stats NZ Agricultural Production Statistics (ADE AGR_AGR_002). Horticulture is collected only in some years. Suppressed cells are left blank.

agr_wine_grapes_area.name: Wine grape area (hectares)
agr_wine_grapes_area.caveat: Wine grape area in Gisborne Region at 30 June, from Stats NZ Agricultural Production Statistics (ADE AGR_AGR_002). Horticulture is collected only in some years. Suppressed cells are left blank.

agr_squash_area.name: Squash area (hectares)
agr_squash_area.caveat: Squash area in Gisborne Region at 30 June, from Stats NZ Agricultural Production Statistics (ADE AGR_AGR_002). Horticulture is collected only in some years. Suppressed cells are left blank.

agr_timber_harvested.name: Exotic timber harvested (cubic metres)
agr_timber_harvested.caveat: Exotic timber harvested in Gisborne Region in the year ended 31 March, from Stats NZ Agricultural Production Statistics (ADE AGR_AGR_001). The published table ends at the year ended March 2018.

msd_main_benefits_total.name: Working-age people on a main benefit
msd_main_benefits_total.caveat: Working-age (18–64) recipients at the end of each quarter. Counts randomly rounded to base 3.

msd_jobseeker.name: Jobseeker Support recipients
msd_jobseeker.caveat: Best Tairāwhiti-only labour-market signal: the HLFS unemployment rate is only published for Gisborne/Hawke's Bay combined.

msd_supported_living.name: Supported Living Payment recipients
msd_supported_living.caveat: Includes carers and people with a health condition or disability; a rise is not necessarily negative.

rent_geomean.name: Mean weekly rent, new bonds (geometric mean)
rent_geomean.caveat: Private-landlord bonds lodged in the month. Fixed random rounding; months with fewer than 5 bonds suppressed.

hud_register_applicants.name: Social housing register applicants
hud_register_applicants.caveat: Housing Register plus Transfer Register, at month end.

hud_social_housing_chp.name: Social housing places – community housing providers

hud_eh_grants.name: Emergency housing grants approved
hud_eh_grants.caveat: Emergency Housing Special Needs Grants. Monthly counts are small and volatile.

imms_6m.name: Children fully immunised at 6 months
imms_6m.caveat: Rolling 12-month coverage by district of residence. National target is 95%.

imms_24m.name: Children fully immunised at 24 months
imms_24m.caveat: Rolling 12-month coverage by district of residence. Health target: 95% by 24 months.

imms_6m_qtr.name: Children fully immunised at 6 months (quarterly)
imms_6m_qtr.caveat: Quarterly cohort (children reaching the milestone in the three months), by district of residence, from April–June 2009. Single quarters are noisier than the rolling 12-month series; do not add quarters together. Schedule changes and new reporting systems from 2020 affect comparison with earlier years; the page links no files for July–December 2020 or April–June 2023.

imms_12m_qtr.name: Children fully immunised at 12 months (quarterly)
imms_12m_qtr.caveat: Quarterly cohort (children reaching the milestone in the three months), by district of residence, from April–June 2009. Single quarters are noisier than the rolling 12-month series; do not add quarters together. Schedule changes and new reporting systems from 2020 affect comparison with earlier years; the page links no files for July–December 2020 or April–June 2023.

imms_24m_qtr.name: Children fully immunised at 24 months (quarterly)
imms_24m_qtr.caveat: Quarterly cohort (children reaching the milestone in the three months), by district of residence, from April–June 2009. Single quarters are noisier than the rolling 12-month series; do not add quarters together. Schedule changes and new reporting systems from 2020 affect comparison with earlier years; the page links no files for July–December 2020 or April–June 2023.

imms_5y_qtr.name: Children fully immunised at 5 years (quarterly)
imms_5y_qtr.caveat: Quarterly cohort (children reaching the milestone in the three months), by district of residence, from April–June 2009. Single quarters are noisier than the rolling 12-month series; do not add quarters together. Schedule changes and new reporting systems from 2020 affect comparison with earlier years; the page links no files for July–December 2020 or April–June 2023. Not published for Tairāwhiti in April–June 2010 (shown as a gap).

hpv_14.name: Rangatahi fully immunised against HPV by age 14
hpv_14.caveat: Young people who turned 14 in the quarter and had all required HPV doses, by district of residence, from July–September 2024. Earlier cohort-based files use a different measure.

pho_enrolled_pct.name: Population enrolled with a PHO
pho_enrolled_pct.caveat: Enrolled people as a share of Health NZ's projected district population, at the start of each quarter from April 2019. The population base is updated about yearly, so the rate can step; it can exceed 100% because enrolments and projections come from different sources.

pho_enrolled.name: People enrolled with a PHO
pho_enrolled.caveat: Enrolled people by district of domicile at the start of each quarter, from April 2019.

nzhs_smoking.name: Adults who currently smoke
nzhs_smoking.caveat: Three-year pooled NZ Health Survey estimate (July–June years) for the former Tairāwhiti DHB, adults 15+, unadjusted. Hollow points mark low-precision estimates (RSE about 30% or more, from the published 95% confidence interval); see the source for intervals. Pooled periods do not overlap and are not combined.

nzhs_hazardous_drinking.name: Adults with a hazardous drinking pattern
nzhs_hazardous_drinking.caveat: Three-year pooled NZ Health Survey estimate (July–June years) for the former Tairāwhiti DHB, adults 15+, unadjusted. Hollow points mark low-precision estimates (RSE about 30% or more, from the published 95% confidence interval); see the source for intervals. Pooled periods do not overlap and are not combined. Total adult population (AUDIT score 8+); first pooled period 2014–17.

nzhs_obesity.name: Adults with obesity
nzhs_obesity.caveat: Three-year pooled NZ Health Survey estimate (July–June years) for the former Tairāwhiti DHB, adults 15+, unadjusted. Hollow points mark low-precision estimates (RSE about 30% or more, from the published 95% confidence interval); see the source for intervals. Pooled periods do not overlap and are not combined.

nzhs_unmet_gp_cost.name: Adults who did not visit a GP due to cost
nzhs_unmet_gp_cost.caveat: Three-year pooled NZ Health Survey estimate (July–June years) for the former Tairāwhiti DHB, adults 15+, unadjusted. Hollow points mark low-precision estimates (RSE about 30% or more, from the published 95% confidence interval); see the source for intervals. Pooled periods do not overlap and are not combined. Past 12 months.

nzhs_psych_distress.name: Adults with high or very high psychological distress
nzhs_psych_distress.caveat: Three-year pooled NZ Health Survey estimate (July–June years) for the former Tairāwhiti DHB, adults 15+, unadjusted. Hollow points mark low-precision estimates (RSE about 30% or more, from the published 95% confidence interval); see the source for intervals. Pooled periods do not overlap and are not combined. Kessler 10 score of 12 or more in the past four weeks.

cas_dsi.name: Road deaths and serious injuries
cas_dsi.caveat: Calendar year. CAS is live: recent years may still change. Current year is year-to-date.

cas_deaths.name: Road deaths
cas_deaths.caveat: Small annual numbers; read multi-year trends, not single years.

mvr_light_fleet.name: Registered light vehicles
mvr_light_fleet.caveat: Light passenger and light goods vehicles (classes MA, MB, MC and NA) on the Motor Vehicle Register at the end of the month, by the registered owner's address in Gisborne District. Vehicles with a confidential owner listing are excluded. Monthly snapshots accumulate from October 2026.

mvr_light_fleet_age.name: Average age of light vehicles
mvr_light_fleet_age.caveat: Years. Snapshot year minus the average vehicle year (year of manufacture) of registered light vehicles with an owner address in Gisborne District.

mvr_light_plugin_share.name: Plug-in share of light vehicles
mvr_light_plugin_share.caveat: Battery electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles as a share of registered light vehicles with an owner address in Gisborne District, from the register's motive power field.

mvr_light_hybrid_share.name: Hybrid share of light vehicles
mvr_light_hybrid_share.caveat: Petrol and diesel hybrids that do not plug in, as a share of registered light vehicles with an owner address in Gisborne District.

sh_traffic_aadt.name: State highway traffic by monitoring site
sh_traffic_aadt.caveat: Annual average daily traffic (vehicles per day, both directions) published for state highway sites in NZTA's Gisborne region, by calendar year. Non-continuous sites are counted for some weeks and adjusted by NZTA. Blank cells have no published count.

court_people_finalised.name: People with finalised charges by court
court_people_finalised.caveat: People of all ages, counted once a year at the court of their most serious finalised charge, for years ended June. Court location is where the final hearing was held, not where people live. Gisborne and Ruatōria courts can serve people who live outside Gisborne District.

court_people_convicted.name: People convicted by court
court_people_convicted.caveat: People of all ages whose most serious finalised charge ended in conviction, by court location, for years ended June. Court location is where the final hearing was held, not where people live.

catalogue.name: Regional GDP
catalogue.note: Stats NZ regional release CSV. Nominal GDP and GDP per person from 2000.

catalogue.name: Modelled TA GDP (MTAGDP)
catalogue.note: Irregular modelled estimates. Use a reviewed official export and retain the model vintage.

catalogue.name: Business Demography Statistics
catalogue.note: ADE BDS_BDS_001

catalogue.name: Linked Employer-Employee Data (LEED)
catalogue.note: ADE LEED_Q1W_005. Quarterly filled jobs, median full-quarter earnings and worker turnover for Gisborne Region, June 1999 quarter onward.

catalogue.name: Monthly Employment Indicators
catalogue.note: Monthly filled jobs for Gisborne Region.

catalogue.name: HLFS – regional
catalogue.note: Combined Gisborne and Hawke’s Bay. Reopen for a credible Tairāwhiti measure.

catalogue.name: Electronic Card Transactions – regional
catalogue.note: No Gisborne series found. The October 2026 release CSV and workbook give national values by industry only, and ADE has no card transactions dataflow. Reopen if Stats NZ publishes regional values.

catalogue.name: Monthly Regional Tourism Estimates
catalogue.note: Historical reference. MBIE paused the series in October 2026. Keep any replacement spend measure separate.

catalogue.name: Tourism Electronic Card Transactions
catalogue.note: Build once MBIE publishes the resumed TECT series with verified local coverage.

catalogue.name: Accommodation Data Programme
catalogue.note: Regional council estimates for commercial guest nights and active establishments, June 2020 onward.

catalogue.name: Regional Economic Activity Web Tool
catalogue.note: Publisher aggregator for source discovery and comparison.

catalogue.name: Agricultural Production Statistics
catalogue.note: ADE AGR_AGR_001–003. Gisborne Region sheep and beef cattle (1994–2025), kiwifruit, apple, wine grape and squash area (1994–2024), and exotic timber harvested (year ended March 2005–2018).

catalogue.name: Building consents issued
catalogue.note: Monthly Gisborne District dwelling counts and construction consent values from Stats NZ release files.

catalogue.name: Residential electricity consumption
catalogue.note: Annual average residential electricity off-take in Gisborne Region, 2016 onward.

catalogue.name: Infometrics regional profile
catalogue.note: Proprietary. Reopen if the publisher grants public redistribution rights.

catalogue.name: Subnational population estimates
catalogue.note: ADE POPES_SUB_011

catalogue.name: Subnational population projections
catalogue.note: Published 2023-base low, medium and high Gisborne Region projection scenarios.

catalogue.name: Births and deaths
catalogue.note: Annual registered births and deaths for Gisborne Region from 2012.

catalogue.name: Census 2013/2018/2023
catalogue.note: Reviewed scope is families and households in occupied private dwellings, 2013–2023.

catalogue.name: Benefit Fact Sheets – regional council
catalogue.note: Rebuilt from archives back to Sept 2013

catalogue.name: Supplementary and hardship assistance
catalogue.note: East Coast service region is wider than Tairāwhiti. Reopen if a local series is released.

catalogue.name: Local Housing Statistics
catalogue.note: Gisborne District median house price to median household income series.

catalogue.name: Change in Housing Affordability Indicators
catalogue.note: Gisborne District deposit, mortgage and rent affordability indices.

catalogue.name: NPS-UD Dashboard
catalogue.note: HUD publishes the urban development dashboard as an interactive app without a downloadable Gisborne series. Other connectors cover several market indicators. H28 records the separate official Urban Land Dashboard price-to-cost release.

catalogue.name: Rental bond data
catalogue.note: Monthly territorial authority CSV from Tenancy Services.

catalogue.name: House sales/prices (REINZ
catalogue.note: Commercial data. Reopen if public redistribution rights are granted.

catalogue.name: Childhood immunisation coverage
catalogue.note: Rolling 12-month files from Oct 2022. Separate quarterly-cohort series from April–June 2009, parsed from the older .xls/.xlsx quarterly files.

catalogue.name: HPV and influenza vaccination
catalogue.note: HPV coverage by age 14 for Tairāwhiti district from July–September 2024. The flu vaccine page shows only the current season as HTML with no archive, so influenza is not yet a series.

catalogue.name: Health targets (ED <6h etc.)
catalogue.note: Review Health NZ targets tables on each release and use only published local cells.

catalogue.name: Quarterly Performance Report (ASH)
catalogue.note: Review Health NZ PDF tables since June 2024. Preserve original definitions and suppression.

catalogue.name: NZ Health Survey – regional
catalogue.note: Pooled 2011–14, 2014–17 and 2017–20 Tairāwhiti estimates from the 2017–20 Regional Data Explorer CSV. The 2011/12–2023/24 regional release on health.govt.nz refuses automated requests and needs a reviewed manual file.

catalogue.name: PHO enrolment
catalogue.note: Quarterly district workbooks from April 2019: people enrolled and the share of Health NZ's projected district population.

catalogue.name: Mortality web tool
catalogue.note: Use a reviewed aggregate mortality export with a verified local geography. The web tool's downloads are generated per session in the Shiny app, so they cannot be fetched repeatably.

catalogue.name: Cancer web tool
catalogue.note: Use an approved aggregate cancer export with publisher suppression preserved. The web tool's downloads are generated per session in the Shiny app, so they cannot be fetched repeatably.

catalogue.name: Suicide web tool
catalogue.note: Use publisher multi-year local rates and preserve suppression and uncertainty. The web tool's downloads are generated per session in the Shiny app, so they cannot be fetched repeatably.

catalogue.name: Victimisations (policedata.nz)
catalogue.note: Police operational areas differ from Gisborne District. Public geographic reports omit victimisations in dwellings except burglary. A repeatable monthly Gisborne District export with documented coverage and suppression is required for a local series.

catalogue.name: Proceedings/offenders
catalogue.note: Eastern police district is wider than Tairāwhiti. Reopen if local proceeding data is released.

catalogue.name: Crash Analysis System
catalogue.note: Public layer is annual (no month field); Gisborne rows from 2006

catalogue.name: Adults with finalised charges / convicted
catalogue.note: People of all ages with finalised and convicted charges at the Gisborne and Ruatōria courts from 2016/17, from the Ministry of Justice people workbook. Court location is not residence.

catalogue.name: Oranga Tamariki / Corrections
catalogue.note: Reopen once a consistent, redistributable Tairāwhiti aggregate is available.

catalogue.name: Motor Vehicle Register; traffic counts
catalogue.note: Monthly Gisborne District light-fleet snapshots from October 2026 and published AADT at state highway sites in NZTA's Gisborne region from 2021.

catalogue.name: Urban Land Dashboard price-to-cost ratio
catalogue.note: Annual new-build sale prices relative to estimated construction costs for total residential dwellings in Gisborne District.

catalogue.name: School attendance
catalogue.note: Gisborne Region regular attendance from 2019. GitHub uses reviewed publisher workbooks when Education Counts blocks downloads.

catalogue.name: Daily attendance dashboard
catalogue.note: Termly attendance covers recurring reporting. Reopen if a reusable and comparable daily local series is available.

catalogue.name: School leavers' attainment
catalogue.note: NCEA Level 2 or above for Gisborne Region school leavers from 2015. Reviewed publisher workbook fallback.

catalogue.name: NZQA secondary statistics
catalogue.note: NCEA Level 1 (participation-based), Levels 2 and 3 and University Entrance (enrolment-based) for schools in NZQA's Gisborne region, 2016 onward. Separate from school leaver attainment. NZQA does not publish regional results by ethnicity.

catalogue.name: ECE participation
catalogue.note: Prior early learning participation for Gisborne District school starters from 2018. Reviewed workbook fallback.

catalogue.name: Stand-downs
catalogue.note: Published annual Gisborne District decision counts, reviewed from the Education Counts workbooks.

catalogue.name: Tertiary participation
catalogue.note: Education Counts is the only verified publisher of tertiary participation by region of residence and refuses automated downloads. A reviewed publisher workbook in data/manual is needed. School-leaver progression is a separate measure.

catalogue.name: School rolls / Māori-medium enrolment
catalogue.note: July school rolls from 1996 and Māori-medium enrolment from 2000, both by school location in Gisborne District. Māori-medium counts combine immersion levels 1 and 2.

catalogue.name: LAWA river water quality
catalogue.note: Stats NZ and Ministry for the Environment monitored-site E. coli medians, 2020–2024.

catalogue.name: LAWA recreational water quality
catalogue.note: Routine river E. coli and coastal enterococci samples by monitoring site and date from LAWA's reviewed release. Check the Council for current swimming advice.

catalogue.name: LAWA groundwater and lakes
catalogue.note: LAWA blocks automated downloads. A reviewed manual file is needed, as for recreational water.

catalogue.name: GDC Hilltop hydrology
catalogue.note: GDC has not published a public Hilltop endpoint. Confirm the server address and reuse terms with GDC before building annual rainfall and river flow aggregates.

catalogue.name: National Climate Database (DataHub)
catalogue.note: DataHub station downloads and its API need a free DataHub account and API key. The Ministry for the Environment data service also needs an API key for its 30-site rainfall and temperature tables.

catalogue.name: GHG emissions by region
catalogue.note: Published industry and household total for Gisborne Region from 2007.

catalogue.name: Land cover / LUCAS
catalogue.note: Irregular land-cover reference. Keep release and classification versions visible.

catalogue.name: GDC Geoportal layers
catalogue.note: Reference maps and monitoring links from Gisborne District Council.

catalogue.name: Tairāwhiti Wellbeing Survey
catalogue.note: Trust stewardship and approval required. Publish only an approved aggregate export.

catalogue.name: General Social Survey
catalogue.note: Reopen when Stats NZ publishes a reliable Tairāwhiti estimate.

catalogue.name: Te Kupenga
catalogue.note: Reopen when a reliable local indicator and reuse terms are verified.

catalogue.name: Census iwi affiliation and te reo
catalogue.note: 2023 aggregate te reo Māori snapshot is published. Iwi affiliation and historical comparability require separate review.

catalogue.name: Local election turnout
catalogue.note: 2022 and 2025 contested mayoral turnout snapshots are published. Earlier releases from 2013 to 2019 still need verification against the official statistics.

catalogue.name: General election enrolment and turnout
catalogue.note: The Electoral Commission publishes enrolment and turnout for the East Coast and Ikaroa-Rāwhiti electorates, which are wider than Gisborne District. The results and enrolment sites block automated downloads.

catalogue.name: Māori Land Online
catalogue.note: Reopen only for an approved aggregate with a clear unit and purpose.

catalogue.name: GDC annual report KPIs
catalogue.note: Council annual-report data. Manually verify definitions and each published year.

catalogue.name: Local authority financial statistics
catalogue.note: Annual operating income and expenditure for Gisborne District Council.

catalogue.name: Cyclone Gabrielle recovery
catalogue.note: Recovery reference material. Preserve publication dates and project context.

catalogue.name: Digital connectivity
catalogue.note: Reference publishers for connectivity until a comparable local series is verified.

catalogue.name: Census place profiles
catalogue.note: Gisborne District Census measures across populated statistical areas on 2023 boundaries.
